baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual construction هذان خصمان is followed by the plural verb اختصموا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dual identifies two sides while the plural verb opens each side into a plurality. The خ ص م inventory joins adversarial contention to the image of an edge or side, so the focus can stage two collective fronts rather than only two isolated persons.

activation_trace.role: Adversarial contention supplies the relation binding the two parties.
The side or edge image lets each grammatical litigant function as a collective front.

changed_reading.after: Two internally plural sides confront one another in a single dispute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dispute is في ربهم and is followed by قطعت لهم ثياب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Within a frame of sovereign lordship, ق ط ع overlays a decision that separates right from wrong with the cutting and fitting of cloth. The garments are therefore not incidental scenery: the judicial distinction is materialized as something cut for and assigned to a party.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty provide the jurisdictional frame.
A decisive separation of right from wrong turns cutting into an adjudicative act.
Cutting and tailoring cloth gives the verdict a fitted material form.
The garment branch makes the assigned result wearable and enclosing.

changed_reading.before: Garments of fire are one item in a punishment list.
changed_reading.after: The losing side wears a verdict that has been cut to fit it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الذين كفروا are assigned ثياب من نار.
baseline_models.mechanism: ك ف ر supplies covering or concealment, while ث و ب supplies both a garment and recompense returning to its doer. The ones characterized by covering are themselves covered by a fiery return, so concealment is reversed into an inescapably manifest covering.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the action that will be materially reversed.
Recompense returning to its worker makes the garment a returned consequence.
Clothing converts the returning consequence into an enclosing cover.
Kindled fire makes the new covering expose and consume instead of protect.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are externally clothed in fire.
changed_reading.after: Their act of covering returns as a covering that can no longer conceal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Fire garments surround the body while boiling liquid is poured من فوق رؤوسهم.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fitted exterior enclosure is coordinated with a downward stream entering from the body's highest point. ف و ق contributes both spatial height and overpowering dominance, making clothing and pouring two vectors of one apparatus rather than unrelated torments.

activation_trace.role: The garment supplies enclosure around the body.
Pouring from a height supplies the descending vector.
Literal upper position locates the stream over the body.
Overpowering superiority gives the vertical arrangement a coercive function.
The head as bodily top fixes the point where domination descends.
Hot water supplies the destructive medium moving through the vertical system.

changed_reading.before: Clothing and poured liquid are adjacent punishment images.
changed_reading.after: They form a coordinated enclosure with pressure descending from above.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first names several communities and says God will separate among them, then answers the focus's fire garments with the believers' silk clothing. The two litigating sides can thus compress many communities into two adjudicated outcomes, each visibly marked by its verdict-material.

activation_trace.role: The side image permits plural communities to be compressed into two fronts.
Judicial cutting connects the focus garments to the surrounding act of separation.
Fire supplies the material livery of one adjudicated outcome.
Judgment separating right from wrong supplies the explicit adjudicative action.
Separation between parties turns the listed communities into distinguishable outcomes.
Clothing supplies the formally parallel covering assigned to the other side.
Fine silk provides the contrasting material of the favorable verdict.

structural_cues: 22:17 lists multiple religious communities before divine separation; 22:23 mirrors 22:19 by assigning clothing to the opposite outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural communities, separation, and opposed garments; I supply the compression of those communities into two verdict-bearing coalitions. A live alternative is that the two litigants are a narrower pair within the listed groups.

changed_reading.before: The two sides are generic collective opponents and only one receives fire clothing.
changed_reading.after: Many communities resolve into two judicial camps whose opposed garments display opposed verdicts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation turns the garment from a static covering into the boundary of a repeated containment cycle. Subduing implements block escape, every attempted exit from enveloping distress is reversed, and the focus roots themselves permit both returning clothing and fettering by pouring.

activation_trace.role: Return within the garment root anticipates the repeated return into confinement.
Putting someone in a fetter lets the pouring root contribute carceral closure.
Subduing and driving back supplies the force that prevents successful exit.
Movement outside names the attempted breach of the enclosure.
Covering and closing over makes distress itself an enveloping medium.
Return after departure closes the escape loop each time it opens.

structural_cues: The كلما ... أعيدوا construction in 22:22 explicitly repeats attempted exit and forced return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, attempted exit, suppression, and repeated return; I supply the arrow that treats the fire garment as the loop's boundary. The live alternative is a sequence of separate punishments without one integrated apparatus.

changed_reading.before: The garment remains on the body as a static penalty.
changed_reading.after: The garment marks a closed system that absorbs every attempt to leave and returns the wearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: What the hands send ahead becomes a precedent, requital answers by likeness, and affairs return to God. These distributed cues strengthen the ث و ب branch of recompense returning to its worker and the ق ط ع branch of tailoring: the fire garment is a made-to-measure return of conduct.

activation_trace.role: Returning recompense supplies the garment's reciprocal temporal motion.
Tailoring supplies individualized fit to the returning consequence.
A deed sent ahead as a precedent supplies the outgoing side of return.
What the hands earn ties the resulting measure to the agents' own action.
Punishment following an act supplies the consequential answer.
Likeness and equivalence supply proportional fit.
Return to what was supplies the surah-wide terminus of the reciprocal motion.

structural_cues: 22:10 states a causal result from what the hands advanced, 22:60 repeats act and answer with بمثل, and 22:76 returns all affairs to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed, likeness, consequence, and return; I supply the arrow from proportional justice to textile fit. The live alternative is general equitable recompense without any intended made-to-measure resonance.

changed_reading.before: A standard fire garment is imposed on a class.
changed_reading.after: Each garment figures conduct returning in a proportion fitted to its maker.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere water descends, enters the earth, and activates movement and growth. In the focus, hot water follows the same downward topology from above but the next ayah makes it melt inner and outer bodily layers. The pour reads as an anti-rain that reverses formation into unmaking.

activation_trace.role: Pouring supplies the liquid's directed descent.
The upper direction aligns the punishment with the surah's rain topology.
Boiling water transforms a normally life-bearing medium into a destructive one.
Descent and arrival supply the generative liquid's matching vertical path.
Delivering water by irrigation or pouring makes the material analogy explicit.
Earth and vegetation moving with life supply the constructive result of descent.
Growth emerging from earth completes the life-producing sequence.
Melting by heat supplies the opposed result, bodily unmaking.
The bodily interior marks how far the destructive descent reaches.
Skin supplies the outer boundary dissolved together with the interior.

structural_cues: 22:5 sequences descending water, enlivened earth, swelling, and growth; 22:19-20 sequences descending hot water and the melting of belly and skin; 22:63 repeats sky-water-green earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored descents with opposed bodily and ecological outcomes; I supply the reversal arrow from rain to anti-rain. The live alternative is that resurrection rain and punishment liquid are independent images sharing only ordinary vertical motion.

changed_reading.before: Boiling water simply intensifies the heat of the fire garments.
changed_reading.after: It is a reversed rain whose descent dismantles embodied form instead of raising life.

context_deltas.mechanism: A garment normally preserves the border at the skin, but the hot pour erases the distinction between skin and belly. Later, sacrificial flesh and blood fail to reach God while inward protection does, and blindness is relocated from eyes to hearts. The fire clothing thus becomes an exposure mechanism: an outward cover cannot protect a concealed interior.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the hidden interior that the mechanism reverses.
The garment supplies the expected protective border at the body's exterior.
Melting abolishes the stability of the exterior-interior boundary.
The belly names the concealed inside reached by the external pour.
Skin names the visible outside that fails to shield the inside.
Literal flesh supplies an outward ritual material explicitly denied access to God.
Literal blood joins flesh as visible matter that does not determine inward standing.
Placing the self in protection supplies the inward quality that does reach God.
Blindness of the heart relocates failure from visible organ to interior faculty.
Physical sight supplies the outward faculty explicitly contrasted with inner blindness.
The heart supplies the concealed site where judgment-relevant perception resides.

structural_cues: 22:20 pairs bellies and skins, 22:37 contrasts visible sacrificial matter with inward protection, and 22:46 contrasts eyes with hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated outside-inside contrasts; I supply the arrow that reads the focus garment and pour as enforced exposure of the concealed self. The live alternative is that the bodily, ritual, and epistemic contrasts remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The scene damages bodies from outside and inside.
changed_reading.after: The fiery covering judicially exposes the interior that outward covering and appearance could not secure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places all creation in voluntary or inherent lowering before God, contrasts honor with humiliation, imagines the associator falling from the sky, and says God alone holds the sky from falling. Against that field, the focus's فوق is moralized: refusal of right vertical alignment becomes involuntary subjection to what descends from above.

activation_trace.role: Dominance from above converts spatial height into imposed subjection.
The body's top receives the downward force and marks reversal of upright control.
Lowering in submission supplies the proper vertical relation immediately before the focus.
Humiliation supplies the social and moral value of forced lowering.
Noisy, uncontrolled falling supplies the associator's failed vertical motion.
Falling into an abyss extends the loss of stable vertical position.
Holding and restraining the sky establishes divine control over descent.
Falling and coming to rest supplies the withheld cosmic counterpart to the focus's pour.

structural_cues: 22:18 places cosmic prostration and human humiliation immediately before 22:19; 22:31 depicts falling from heaven; 22:65 makes heavenly falling subject to divine permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies submission, humiliation, falling, and controlled descent; I supply the arrow from refused voluntary lowering to forced overbearing from above. The live alternative is that these are independent uses of ordinary vertical imagery.

changed_reading.before: From above merely locates the source of the boiling liquid.
changed_reading.after: The descent enacts a reversal from refused submission to imposed vertical subjection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the illumination and kindled-fire branches of ن و ر. It remains anchored in the focus's نار, its كفر covering language, and the same root at 22:8 and 22:72; downstream prose should present it as lexical resonance, not as an asserted identity between scripture and punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الذين كفروا ... ثياب من نار joins covering, clothing, and the fire member of the ن و ر inventory.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the refusal or concealment that the outlier reverses.
Kindled fire supplies compulsory, destructive visibility.
Illumination supplies the rejected mode of disclosure earlier in the surah.
Promised fire reunites disbelief and the kindled-fire branch near the surah's close.
Rejection of truth identifies the group whose resisted disclosure returns as fire.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only the substance from which the garments are made.
changed_reading.after: Fire may resonate as illumination returning in an unbearable form to those who covered disclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مقامع الحديد is normally carried by its subduing or striking sense, while its packet inventory also contains a pouring funnel. The reading remains anchored in the immediately preceding يصب and following return sequence; downstream prose should retain it only as an apparatus-level echo, never replace the ordinary implement sense with a funnel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يصب ... الحميم establishes controlled pouring immediately before the iron مقامع.

activation_trace.role: Directed pouring supplies the operation echoed by the neighboring implement.
Hot water supplies the material being controlled in the apparatus reading.
The funnel or pouring-tool branch creates the unusual mechanical echo.
Subduing and driving back preserves the ordinary coercive function of the implements.
Forced return lets pouring and striking belong to one recirculating system.

changed_reading.before: Iron maces are a separate striking punishment after the pour.
changed_reading.after: Their branch field faintly echoes a controlled pouring-and-return apparatus while retaining their coercive sense.

strongest_changes: The dual-plus-plural litigants became collective judicial camps, and 22:17 plus 22:23 made their fire and silk garments opposed verdict-liveries.
Return, in-kind requital, and failed escape turned the cut garment into both a fitted consequence and the boundary of a recurring confinement loop.
The surah's rain, skin-belly, flesh-heart, and sight-heart contrasts changed the hot pour into anti-creative descent and enforced exposure of the concealed interior.
Cosmic prostration and controlled falling moralized فوق as a reversal from refused submission to imposed subjection.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made legal, textile, ecological, bodily, and vertical branch images converge on the focus without requiring one final interpretation; the most productive pivots were ق ط ع, ث و ب, ك ف ر, ن و ر, and the dual-plural grammar of خ ص م.
remaining_uncertainties: The two litigants may denote all ultimate human camps or a narrower pair within the communities named in 22:17.
The recompense sense of ث و ب and the illumination-fire crossing of ن و ر may be evocative root play rather than compositional semantics.
The anti-rain and inside-out models depend on reader-supplied analogical arrows across separated passages.
The funnel branch of ق م ع is worth preserving only as a highly qualified mechanical echo.
